title: Unify waiver partition logic into a waivers module (code seam)
description: Create a waivers module with WaiverTarget enum (Constraint, Convention, HealthFinding), a Waivable trait (finding → match key), and a single partition(findings, waivers) -> (active, waived) function. Replace the six hand-rolled partition loops at call sites. Three DB impls stay as row adapters behind the module. Add reconcile-orphans for health waivers (currently missing). Schema merge into one durable table deferred per ADR-0002 — separate change if ever pursued.
implementation_plan: Wave 1: waivers module + constraint impl. Wave 2: convention impl. Wave 3: health impl + reconcile-orphans. See plan file for details.
execution_record: Three commits: (1) waivers module with Waivable trait, partition fn, ConstraintFinding impl — replaces both evaluate_dd and evaluate_raw hand-rolled loops, fixes evaluate_raw symbol_qualified_name inconsistency. (2) ConventionViolation impl with ConventionWaiverSet — replaces 4-way probe in review.rs, removes WaivedViolation. (3) ResolvedHealthFinding impl — get_health_findings_with_waiver_status routes through partition internally, adds reconcile_orphaned_health_waivers. Net +110 lines (125 new module, -171 deleted partition loops + types, +156 tests/adapters). All 805 tests pass.

messages.author: codex
messages.text:
Codex review: needs-attention.

Finding (medium): `reconcile_orphaned_health_waivers` (src/db/health.rs:281-288) only joins on `biomarker_kind` + `file_path`, ignoring `symbol_qualified_name`. A symbol-scoped waiver for `src/foo.rs::old_fn` won't be flagged as orphaned if another `nested_complexity` finding exists in `src/foo.rs` for a different symbol. This leaves stale durable waivers that could silently reactivate if a future symbol reuses the qualified name.

Recommendation: Mirror the matcher semantics in SQL — for `w.symbol_qualified_name IS NULL`, require any finding for the same biomarker/file; for non-null symbol waivers, join `health_findings` → `symbols` and require `s.qualified_name = w.symbol_qualified_name`. Add a regression test with two findings in one file where the waived symbol disappears but another same-biomarker finding remains.
